name: Conquest
source:
Algiz is an adventurer from the Town of Mannaz who makes a living doing quests. In his adventures, he meets multiple characters with different stories and ambitions. In his journey, Algiz finds himself falling in love with the  characters (of your choice!) and slowly reveals the forgotten memories of his past.

Set on an immersive experience in a fantasy world of different races,  where love knows no boundaries, what secrets will unfold in the end?  and will Algiz remember who he was? Play as Algiz and discover his  deepest desires!

(from kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theyaoiarmy/conquest-bl-yaoi-visual-novel )
translation:
阿尔吉兹是来自曼纳兹镇的冒险家，以做任务为生。在他的冒险中，他遇到了多个有着不同故事和野心的角色。在他的旅程中，阿尔吉兹发现自己爱上了角色（由你选择！），并慢慢地揭示了他被遗忘的过去记忆。

身临其境的异族奇幻世界，爱情无国界，最终会揭开什么秘密？阿尔吉兹会记得他是谁吗？扮演Algiz并发现他最深的渴望！

（来自kickstarter：https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theyaoarmy/conquest-bl-yaoi-visual-novel）
